entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: A Rift Era event on Mirrodin in which many denizens suddenly disappeared, returned to their origin planes after Memnarch's defeat.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane where the Vanishing occurred.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: An insane artifact being who abducted beings from other planes using soul traps.

entities.name: Soul traps
entities.description: Arcane machines Memnarch devised to pluck beings from other planes and relocate them to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin who received the latent energies of the soul traps and gave up his spark to return Mirrodin's denizens.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who offered to mentor Slobad.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Origin of the spark Slobad had been granted; returned from oblivion.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Returned from oblivion when Slobad gave up the spark.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: One of the Vanished who ended up on an unnamed plane.

entities.name: Lume
entities.description: City founded by the Vanished on an unnamed plane.

entities.name: Jilad
entities.description: City founded by the Vanished on an unnamed plane.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Called the Vanishing the Sun's Toll.

events.summary: Memnarch, corrupted by glistening oil, devises soul traps to abduct beings from other planes and seed Mirrodin with organic life.
events.quote: Over time, he devised the soul traps

events.summary: After Memnarch's defeat, the soul traps' latent energies are sent into the goblin Slobad.
events.quote: when the latent energies of the soul traps were sent into the goblin Slobad

events.summary: Karn offers to mentor Slobad, who instead wants to undo Memnarch's works.
events.quote: who offered to take him on as his mentor

events.summary: Slobad gives up his spark, returning Glissa, Geth and most people on the surface from oblivion.
events.quote: returning Glissa, Geth , and most people on the surface from oblivion

events.summary: The souls of the eldest transplanted beings are wrenched from Mirrodin and returned to their origin planes.
events.quote: The souls of the eldest transplanted beings were wrenched from Mirrodin and returned to their planes of origin

events.summary: Raksha Golden Cub, Bruenna, Lyese, Dwugget and Ushanti land on one unnamed plane, founding Lume and Jilad.
events.quote: founding the cities of Lume and Jilad
